faq.title: Questions we hear often
faq.callText: Something else on your mind? Call us at

items.a: A C-level marketing executive who works inside your company part-time. They own the marketing strategy and budget, lead your team and vendors, and deliver the go-to-market playbook, for a fraction of the cost of a full-time hire.

items.q: How is that different from hiring an agency?
items.a: An agency is a vendor hired for specific tasks and sits outside your daily operations. A Fractional CMO is a fiscally responsible member of your executive team, accountable for the overall strategy, not just the materials.

items.q: Do you work with companies outside the U.S.?
items.a: Yes. We help U.S. companies enter markets abroad and source products, materials, and manufacturers internationally, with contacts and resources in the U.S. and overseas.

items.q: Can you help us prepare to sell the business?
items.a: Yes. We support exit planning, and we run target-company and market research, including customer diligence, for private equity firms and M&A professionals.

items.q: What does the first conversation look like?
items.a: A free strategy call. No pitch deck: we ask about your company, your market, and what you’re trying to grow, then tell you honestly whether and where we can help.
